verdict.rationale: Phaser's core game framework is fully open-source (GitHub) and distributed via npm or CDN with no server-side/cloud dependency — a developer downloads it and runs the entire engine within their own project, which inherently satisfies self-hosting for the core library. Missing for 10: explicit documentation or independent confirmation addressing offline/self-hosted deployment as a stated goal (the docs only cover installation, not self-hosting philosophy), and clarity that the separate paid Editor/Agent MCP services are not required for core use.
